name: Mysterious Woman
source:
A mysterious woman who meets the protagonist in the real world. 

She appears in front of him on a sunny day, wearing a raincoat and rainboots.

She is tall and has stunning red hair.

Her words and actions are aloof and to the point, which confuses the protagonist.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=707787&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
